## 💫 About Me

- 🔭 I'm currently working as an **AI Engineer at TKMiND**, building intelligent AI-powered solutions.
- 🎓 I hold a **B.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence** from Egyptian Russian University.
- 🤝 I'm looking to collaborate on **AI Agents, Agentic AI, RAG Systems, LLM Fine-Tuning, and AI Automation**.
- 🧠 I'm passionate about building **production-ready AI systems**, including intelligent retrieval pipelines, customized LLMs, and autonomous AI agents.
- 🌱 I'm continuously exploring **Agentic AI, LangGraph, MCP, LLMOps, Fine-Tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), and advanced AI architectures**.
- 💬 Ask me about **LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Fine-Tuning, NLP, LangChain, LangGraph, and AI Automation**.
- ⚡ Fun fact: I enjoy turning complex AI concepts into practical, scalable solutions that solve real-world problems.

## 🚀 What I Build

| Area | What that covers |
| --- | --- |
| 🤖 **Agentic AI** | Single and multi-agent systems, tool calling, MCP servers, human-in-the-loop workflows, agent memory |
| 🔎 **RAG Systems** | Ingestion pipelines, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, GraphRAG, retrieval evaluation |
| 🎯 **LLM Fine-Tuning** | Dataset preparation, LoRA/QLoRA training, quantization, model evaluation |
| 🚢 **LLMOps** | Model serving, tracing, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency monitoring |
| ⚡ **AI Automation** | LLM-powered workflows connecting APIs, data sources, and business tools |
